run_mse_evaluation: run the mse evaluation script on a trained autoencoder with an experiment config file
run_mse_with_mask: run the mse evaluation script with image masking enabled using the usemask flag
run_mse_with_scripting: run the mse evaluation script with torch jit scripting enabled for faster inference
run_mse_with_custom_profile: run the mse evaluation script with a custom config profile other than the default Eval
run_mse_with_batchsize: run the mse evaluation script with a custom batch size for the data loader
